verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email has a documented API, covering contacts, lists, campaigns, reports, domains and scoped keys, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the features page only describes capabilities in marketing prose.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
